summary: Tested the iteration-4 changes on the backend and frontend: real XLSX/PDF exports, removal of demo data, the dashboard weekly array, report shape, cash reconciliation, all CRUD modals, downloads and mobile layout. One real bug: in the PDF every Turkish Lira sign (₺) shows as an empty box, because the bundled Liberation Sans 1.07.4 fonts have no U+20BA glyph. Everything else passed. When testing finished the DB was empty: all records I created and the main agent's 2 seed records were deleted by id.

critical.issue: The ₺ symbol shows as an empty box in every money cell. Text extraction gives \x00. Cause: /app/backend/fonts/LiberationSans-*.ttf is version 1.07.4 and its cmap has no U+20BA. The other Turkish letters (ğ ş ı İ ö ü ç Ö Ü Ç â) and − show correctly.

minor.issue: Table headers use ... in Paragraph, but registerFontFamily('Sans', normal='Sans', bold='Sans-Bold') is never called. The headers render in the regular weight, not bold, and a Helvetica (F1) font gets embedded.
'Today' and the period windows use UTC dates. For a Turkish restaurant (UTC+3), sales made between 00:00 and 03:00 local time count toward the previous day.

issues: Days with zero revenue or expenses still show small stub bars (CSS min-height), so an empty week looks like it has a little data. Consider 0 height or a muted baseline.

The frontend sets link.download to 'gokboss-pos-{period}-rapor.{ext}', which overrides the dated filename the backend sends in Content-Disposition. The anchor is never added to the DOM, and revokeObjectURL runs right after click(), which can break downloads in Firefox and Safari. Works in Chromium.

action_items: Fix the missing ₺ glyph in the PDF. Bundle a font that has U+20BA, such as DejaVuSans / DejaVuSans-Bold or Liberation Sans 2.x, and register it in exports.py. The other option is to write 'TL' instead of '₺' in the PDF.
Call pdfmetrics.registerFontFamily('Sans', normal='Sans', bold='Sans-Bold', italic='Sans', boldItalic='Sans-Bold') so the <b> headers come out bold.
Optional: escape user text (xml.sax.saxutils.escape) before passing it to Paragraph in build_pdf. In this test '&' and '<' happened not to crash it, but escaping is safer.
Optional: use the server's Content-Disposition filename, append the anchor to the DOM, and delay revokeObjectURL.
critical_code_review_comments: exports.py: user strings (product names, notes) are placed straight into reportlab Paragraph markup. Values like '<b' or '&amp' could produce broken or garbled PDFs. Escape them first.
server.py: list_items for the dashboard lists is capped at 100 docs. The weekly and today totals use separate unlimited queries, so they are correct, but the lists are truncated.
server.py: uses @app.on_event('shutdown'), which is deprecated. Prefer a lifespan handler (minor).

success_rate.backend: 79% (11/14 pytest; the 3 failures are the same ₺ glyph bug in daily/weekly/monthly PDF)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ sales, expenses, cash, product, inventory and staff records through pytest and the UI. All were deleted by id, along with the main agent's 2 records (sale 3dfbe7e7..., expense 4a6b2fb0...) as requested. Every collection is now empty (verified with GET).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_exports.py needs pymupdf (fitz) for PDF text extraction. I pip-installed it in the test env; it is not in requirements. The DB was left empty on purpose for the user's real use, so any test must clean up after itself. Verified on desktop: modal adds update the metrics, the chart (today's bar), the recent-sales list, stock alerts, reconciliation (opening from the earliest log, closing from the latest) and the reports. All 6 downloads (3 periods x pdf/xlsx) fired real files. No 2024 dates, the current date is shown, no demo data appears on an empty DB, and the 390px mobile layout has no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: The ₺ boxes in the PDF come from the font: Liberation Sans 1.07.4 predates the Turkish Lira sign (Unicode 6.2, 2012) and has no glyph for it. I confirmed this with fontTools: 0x20BA is not in the cmap. Reproduce: GET /api/reports/export?period=daily&format=pdf, then render or extract the text; each money value ends with \x00 or a tofu box. Fix: switch to a font that has the glyph (DejaVu Sans or Liberation Sans 2.x).
